exposure: knowledge, attitudes, and practices of hygiene
cohort: This study included 132 children and their caretakers in a suburban area of China
finding: The study found that approximately 20% of children experienced delayed achievement of certain gross motor milestones; children from high-income families were more likely to experience developmental delay than those from middle-income; and continued breastfeeding at one year and superior hygiene potentially improved motor development.
followup_time: The study assessed children's nutritional status and gross motor milestones, suggesting an approximate age range of 0-2 years.
